literal_meaning: চোখ টিপে টিপে দেখা বা নকল করা (peeking or copying by glancing)
figurative_meaning_en: Cheating or copying in an exam
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরীক্ষায় টোকাটুকি করে সে ভালো নম্বর পেয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He got good marks by tokatuki in the exam.
The teacher caught him doing tokatuki.
note: Commonly used in student contexts to describe sneaky copying methods.
